Issue #260: ci: isolate scope classifier cases and cover GH-AW source Markdown
Issue URL: https://github.com/jboone1989/EventGraph/issues/260
Spec: specs/012-github-hosted-agent-queue/spec.md@19e5577f648a45c2d51329de6d5a18b4dd867cba
Spec PR: https://github.com/jboone1989/EventGraph/pull/254

Task:
Strengthen the existing CI scope-classifier regression tests as the write-capable acceptance Work for the repaired native queue. Read the pinned approved Spec and existing scripts/ci/scope-changes.test.mjs before editing. Its table-driven tests currently retain one temporary Git repository across cases and compare every later case to the original base: the first executable change therefore contaminates later cases and can hide a broken classification rule. Give each case its own clean fixture and cleanup, reusing the existing fixture/commit/classify helpers and node:test.

Cover GH-AW source Markdown independently: a commit changing only .github/workflows/eventgraph-worker.md, and a separate commit changing only .github/workflows/eventgraph-dispatcher.md, must each force docs_only=false. Add a separate docs/ci-cd.md-only control that yields docs_only=true. These tests protect the approved rule that executable workflow prompts require full CI while ordinary documentation retains its existing path. Preserve the classifier implementation and existing public behavior. Do not introduce frameworks, change workflow gates, application code, deployment settings or approved Specs.

Copy this Issue's Spec and Spec PR lines into the PR body as exact standalone, unfenced lines. Trusted main control-plane instruction folders may be restored over the develop checkout; use the existing develop test file for this task, and keep the PR diff limited to that file.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Each case in the existing executable-file and non-prose-file tables runs against a fresh isolated temporary Git repository and always cleans it up, so earlier executable changes cannot determine later results.
- [ ] Independently changing only the Worker Markdown or only the Dispatcher Markdown yields docs_only=false; independently changing only docs/ci-cd.md yields docs_only=true.
- [ ] Run node --test scripts/ci/scope-changes.test.mjs and report the actual result in the PR body.
- [ ] Only scripts/ci/scope-changes.test.mjs changes. Preserve all existing assertions and gates; do not modify classifier behavior, dependencies, workflows or Specs.
- [ ] Create exactly one non-draft agent-work PR to develop with the immutable Spec reference, Spec PR URL, this Issue URL and required original Work/Worker marker. Let the trusted pipeline run full exact-SHA CI, independent review, normal merge and publish/resume.

Issue #276: Story 详情：无影响线索/无市场快照/无官方来源时不堆 0 条卡片（P-4）
Issue URL: https://github.com/jboone1989/EventGraph/issues/276
Spec: specs/story-detail-dedup/spec.md@80c1cd0de73da6f691c50960c685fb9c5bd185fa
Spec PR: https://github.com/jboone1989/EventGraph/pull/269

Task:
实现 specs/story-detail-dedup 的 P-4（原 SD-04）：Story 详情页在无影响线索、无市场快照、无官方来源时不堆叠 0 条卡片；在无证据时不推断「无影响」或「无官方立场」，未知即未知。只做本条验收内的改动，复用现有组件与数据通道，不做无关重构，不新建通用服务。

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] 无影响线索、无市场快照、无官方来源的 Story 详情页不再渲染对应的 0 条卡片或空板块。
- [ ] 无证据时页面不出现「无影响」「无官方立场」等推断性文案。
- [ ] 有数据的 Story 详情页行为不变，并为上述空态行为补充聚焦测试。
- [ ] 相关检查通过，PR 记录实际运行结果。
